text:
mason: Heads up — NimbusEdge + CloudIntegrator asked for marketplace evidence for the upcoming listing. They specifically called out: SOC2 excerpt, pen-test executive summary, and firmware attestation artifacts. Need clear owners and a redaction/upload plan.

liam: Can we split owners by cohort (firmware / SI integration / cloud listing)? I can own SI artifacts and the questionnaire responses.

julia: I can own firmware attestation and hashes. Quick Q: do they want entire SOC2 or just control excerpts (CC6/CC7)? Also presigned link or secure upload?

security-bot: Checklist reminder: SOC2 Type II (redact PII), Pen-test executive summary + remediation plan (no vuln file with creds), Firmware attestation + signed hash, Supply-chain Qs answered. Preferred transfer: presigned S3 with TTL=7d or secure scp to partner SFTP. Upload cutoff: 72h before listing. See internal guide: /compliance/marketplace-evidence.md

mason: Good. @nina can you coordinate presigns + redaction? We need an evidence index with owner tags and retention TTL. Also confirm whether partners accept exec summary only for pen test.

nina: On it. I'll generate presigned URLs and add owner metadata. Quick note: partner legal prefers exec summary + remediation timeline, not full vuln exports. I'll confirm and report back today.

liam: Owners (tentative): SI artifacts -> liam; firmware -> julia; SOC reports -> mason; presigns/uploads -> nina. I'll draft the questionnaire answers for SI sections.

julia: Also note: NimbusEdge asked for firmware hash signing method (they accept RSA-2048 signatures). I'll add a short runbook for signing and provide sample command.

julia: ```
# sign firmware hash (example)
sha256sum image.bin > image.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /keys/release_rsa.pem -out image.sha256.sig image.sha256
```

mason: Timeline: partner expects final evidence by Mon 2026-03-15 COB. We will do an internal dry-run Fri 2026-03-12. If anything slips, escalate here.

nina: I'll loop in @elaine-marketing for embargo/announcement sync. Marketing wants a 2-week embargo after acceptance for joint announcement.

elaine-marketing: Thanks — once evidence is ingested, please DM me the go/no-go by EOD so marketing can align press cadence and the announcement blurb.

security-bot: Created task: marketplace-evidence-199876 (assignees: mason, liam, julia, nina) due: 1998765432 + 7d.

mason: One more housekeeping item — redaction responsibilities: 1) SOC2 -> redact human names/email; 2) Pen test -> provide exec summary only; 3) Firmware -> provide signed hash + attestation doc that omits debug artifacts. Nina will handle the redaction checklist.

nina: I'll produce a redaction checklist and a sample redacted SOC excerpt by tomorrow morning.

liam: If partners request full pen-test after NDA, we'll route to security for controlled sharing. For listing, exec summary should suffice.

mason: Great. If there are no blockers, let's hit the dry-run on Fri. Post any blockers here so we can reassign quickly.

julia: 👍

liam: :thumbsup:

nina: Will update thread with presign links and the evidence index when ready.

security-bot: Note: store final artifacts in compliance-bucket/marketplace/199876/ with access logs enabled. Presign template: `aws s3 presign s3://compliance-bucket/marketplace/199876/<file> --expires-in 604800`

mason: Perfect — thanks everyone.
